title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Monthly Interest Methodology
content:
**Method.** The monthly interest for a statement period on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion is the account balance carried on the day the interest is posted times one twelfth of the annual rate, rounded to the cent. The annual rate is the plan's purchase APR, reduced by the plan's autopay discount while autopay is enrolled on that day, and it never falls below zero. The balance carried is the funded principal plus every interest, fee and returned-payment entry, less every payment and fee reversal.

## Elements of the method

| Element | Definition |
|---|---|
| Balance carried | Funded principal, plus every interest entry, fee entry and returned-payment entry on the account, less every payment and every fee reversal, as they stand on the posting day |
| Annual rate | The plan's purchase APR, less the plan's autopay APR discount when autopay is enrolled on the posting day; never below zero |
| Monthly interest | The balance carried times one twelfth of the annual rate |
| Rounding | Only the interest is rounded, to the nearest cent; an exact half cent rounds up |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures, not plan rates)

Balance carried 10000.00; purchase APR 9.00%; autopay discount 0.25%.

- Autopay enrolled on the posting day: annual rate 8.75%; one twelfth of it applied to 10000.00 gives 72.9166, so the interest is 72.92.
- Autopay not enrolled: annual rate 9.00%; the interest is 75.00.

## Balance carried (hypothetical entries)

Funded principal 12000.00; interest entries 410.50; a late fee 25.00 later reversed; one returned payment 180.00; payments 1980.00. The balance carried is 12000.00 plus 410.50, 25.00 and 180.00, less 1980.00 and 25.00: 10610.50.
